args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, which broke tests/test_money.py in the nightly build.
Fix the rounding mode to match FIN-212.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- Changed `round_money()` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212.
- No test changes needed; the existing assertions (`2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`) now pass.

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).

## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- Changed `round_money()` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` via `Decimal.quantize`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212.
- No test changes needed; the existing assertions (`2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`) now pass.

## CI
CI run `ci-0002` on commit `0a9452f727` passed (includes merge of latest main).
